necessary_context.content: F(x)=f(x,y*(x)), y*(x)=argmin_y g(x,y), over full Euclidean spaces. Assumption 3.1: g(x,·) is μ-strongly convex; ||f_y||≤C_f; Lip(∇f)≤L_f and Lip(∇g)≤L_g globally; g_yy and g_xy are jointly ρ-Lipschitz; F(x0)−inf F≤Δ. Uniform upper bounds additionally use ||y_init−y*(x0)||≤R0<∞.
necessary_context.name: Problem and regularity

necessary_context.applies_to: Upper theorem and lower-bound proof method
necessary_context.content: At each adaptive (x,y), one raw SFO call returns a fresh pair of full gradient vectors with conditional means ∇f,∇g and separate squared-error bounds σ_f²,σ_g². Pairwise independence within a call is not asserted. Only that queried point is returned; no reusable sample, free inner solution or HVP is supplied. T_SFO takes infimum over algorithms of supremum-instance expected raw calls subject to supremum-instance E||∇F(xhat)||≤ε. Fixed-horizon lower bounds separately impose N_A≤N almost surely.
necessary_context.name: Oracle and resource convention

necessary_context.content: k=L_g/μ, κ=L/μ, θ=ρ/μ, χ=1+θ. Normalized rate summaries assume C_f,L_f,L_g=O(L). General positive-variation leading lower and upper coefficients are χ²κ⁸ and χ³κ⁸; they match the ε exponent, not all parameters. Curvature-controlled matching adds Lip(∇F)=O(Lκ²).
